description: email.rs extract_header_values (~line 297): for every header entry in the email's headers array, name.to_ascii_lowercase() allocates a new String for comparison against req.name_lower. With H headers per email, R header: property requests, and E emails in the response, this is O(H*R*E) String allocations. The header names in storage are fixed at ingest time; case-folding them to lowercase once on ingest (or storing them pre-lowercased) would eliminate all allocations here. Alternatively, a case-insensitive byte comparison (AsciiExt or manual fold-on-compare) avoids allocation entirely.
title: extract_header_values: to_ascii_lowercase() alloc per header per request
